SELECT pl.*,
(6371 * ACOS( COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(pl.lat AS DECIMAL(18,8)))) * COS(RADIANS(CAST(pl.lng AS DECIMAL(18,8))) - RADIANS(#{lng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(CAST(pl.lat AS DECIMAL(18,8)))) )) AS distance
NULL AS distance
FROM distribution_pickup_location pl WHERE pl.company_id = #{companyId} AND pl.rel_distributor_id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY distance ASC
ORDER BY pl.created DESC
LIMIT 100
